Package view.ui

Class PauseOverlay

java.lang.Object
view.ui.PauseOverlay
public class PauseOverlay extends Object
The PauseOverlay class represents the overlay displayed when the game is paused. It handles the background, sound buttons, and URM (User Request Management) buttons.
